name: LoupeLedger
tagline: Authenticate every consignment before it hits your shelf.
positioning: LoupeLedger gives resale shops a shared authentication workspace — capture, verify, and log every luxury item with an audit trail buyers actually trust.

hero.h1: Prove it's real before you price it.
hero.sub: LoupeLedger walks your team through a structured authentication check for every handbag, watch, and pair of sneakers — then hands your buyer a verifiable record they can trust.

features.title: Guided check by brand
features.description: Step-by-step prompts for date codes, hardware, stitching, and serials — tailored to each maison so a new hire can authenticate like a ten-year veteran.

features.title: Photo evidence, timestamped
features.description: Capture the microstamp, heat stamp, and receipt in one flow. Every image is logged, dated, and locked to the item's record.

features.title: Shareable certificates
features.description: Generate a clean authentication summary with a scannable code your buyer can verify — cuts the 'is this legit?' emails to zero.

features.title: Consignment audit trail
features.description: See who checked what, when, and why an item passed or got flagged. Settle disputes with a record instead of a memory.

features.title: Counterfeit flag alerts
features.description: Known fake indicators surface mid-check, so a suspect serial gets held before it ever reaches your floor or your listing.

features.title: Multi-location inventory
features.description: Run one authentication standard across every storefront and back room, whether you have one appraiser or a bench of six.

testimonials.quote: We used to keep authentication notes in a shared spreadsheet and pray. Now every Chanel flap has a full record with photos. Our repeat buyers stopped second-guessing us.
testimonials.name: Marisol Fenn

testimonials.quote: Training seasonal staff on Hermès hardware took weeks. LoupeLedger's guided checks got a new hire authenticating confidently in two days.
testimonials.name: Darnell Boyce

testimonials.quote: A customer disputed a watch six months after purchase. I pulled the timestamped serial photos in thirty seconds. Case closed, no chargeback.
testimonials.name: Priya Vasquez

pricing.blurb: For the single-shop owner who authenticates everything themselves.
For growing teams that need one standard across the bench.
For multi-store operators and franchise resale groups.
